input.sources: Map named exactly as SOURCE-BASIS.sources; each value contains raw whole UTF-8 source text plus blob/bytes/sha256. Obtain raw from that immutable Git blob, never from host.
input.request_values: two parsed request files in the prescribed order

hash_helpers: sha256 and SHA1 of binary byte strings; verifier performs its own UTF-8 encoding and Git blob envelope
effects: Pure strings/JSON/arithmetic/hashes only. No filesystem/Runtime/SDK/source-function invocation.
result: Named finite source-binding checks and explicit scope. Not product tests.
